structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: No liability for nonnegligent performance of operation
law.text: Subject to the rules of law applicable generally to negligence, no physician licensed by the Board of Medicine shall be either civilly or criminally liable by reason of having performed a vasectomy, salpingectomy, or other surgical sexual sterilization procedure upon any person in this Commonwealth as authorized by this article.
